messages:
sara (docs): FYI I opened a small PR to tidy up the Optimize toolkit docs: trimmed the batching guidance, added a short caching example, and swapped the python SDK snippet to the new streaming API. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/491 :memo:

 diego (optimize): thanks. can we add an explicit "when not to batch" short note? customers hit OOM with naive large-batch for long-context runs.

 sara (docs): good call. i'll add a one-liner recommending batch ceiling based on (model_seq_len * batch_size) and a quick formula.

 lina (eng-ml): also add a note about KV cache eviction when using dynamic batching + multi-tenant nodes. it can cause spiky latency if cache thrashes.

 sara (docs): added an example: "set max_ongoing_requests and enable prefix cache pinning for chat endpoints" + link to internal runbook.

 noah (sdk): i fixed the old python snippet that used generate_stream; new SDK uses `stream_responses`. Example I pushed in the PR: ```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=os.getenv('RWD_KEY'))
for part in client.stream_responses(model='rwd-mixtral-8x', prompt='Write a haiku'):
    print(part.delta, end='')
```

 qa-bot: Link check: /eng-runtime/old-batching-notes.md -> 404 (moved).

 sara (docs): thanks qa-bot. replaced that link with /eng-runtime/batching-scheduler.md and updated the anchor.
 diego (optimize): can we add a short migration checklist for customers moving from hosted -> dedicated? key things: pin model version, pin quant_profile, test with a 50-seed prompt set, and validate latency under canary.

 sara (docs): added checklist bullets. also put a short bullet about quant_profile naming: "use conservative if you need deterministic outputs; aggressive for best memory savings but run quality regression tests".

 lina (eng-ml): re: quant: add a one-liner about non-determinism sources (hf tokenizer vs internal tokenization differences) when switching quant backends. it saves a lot of support time.

 sara (docs): added that note and suggested a quick tokenization parity check command.

 noah (sdk): i added a JS snippet to the PR showing reconnect + fallback to non-streaming if the client detects partial frames. Uses `client.on('reconnect', ...)` in the snippet; also added min SDK versions.

 noah (sdk): small nit: changed the sample to `model: 'rwd-mixtral-8x-q8'` to demonstrate picking a quant profile suffix.

 diego (optimize): please add a short cost note: expected memory savings with q8 ~ 25-40% depending on layer type; with nf4 variants maybe 40-60% but watch for token-level hallucinations on small prompts. keep it short.

 sara (docs): added a 2-sentence tradeoffs paragraph and a quick AB test suggestion: "compare outputs on 100 seeded prompts; metric: exact-match and a manual spot-check".

 qa-bot: Lint: code block line-wrapping in the JS snippet flagged.

 sara (docs): fixed formatting. pushed.

 noah (sdk): FYI the CI flagged a failing example in the CLI microbench: the curl sample used `--data-binary` incorrectly. I pushed a tiny fix.

 sara (docs): thanks. also added a tiny microbench script that runs 10 requests with and without prefix caching and prints p50/p95 latency.
 diego (optimize): looks much cleaner now. one last ask: include recommended default batch windows per family but phrase as guidance not rules. e.g. suggestion: small=32-96, medium=8-32, large=1-8 (callout about seq_len).

 sara (docs): added those ranges and emphasized sequence-length dependency.

 lina (eng-ml): can you add a short pointer to the perf team issue where we'll attach CSVs for Mixtral runs later?

 sara (docs): done: linked to https://github.com/redwood-inference/perf/issues/54 and created a follow-up issue on the docs repo to attach results when available (https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/134).

 noah (sdk): approving once QA-bot green. also, we should note required SDK versions near snippets: JS >= 0.9.4, Python >= 1.2.1.

 qa-bot: All links resolved. Code lint passed. spellcheck: suggested changing "kv-cache" -> "KV cache" in one heading.

 sara (docs): updated heading casing, pushed final commit. PR 491 ready to merge. :white_check_mark:

 diego (optimize): merged. thanks team! :rocket:

 sara-bot: Thread archived after merge.
